description: Source code implementing DNS utility functions for mDNS endpoints and HTTPS query name generation within the Chromium project.

methods.name: GetMdnsIPEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the IPEndPoint for a given multicast IP address literal.

methods.name: GetMdnsGroupEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the multicast group endpoint based on the address family (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: GetMdnsReceiveEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint for receiving mDNS messages, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: GetNameForHttpsQuery
methods.description: Generates a DNS query name for HTTPS based on the URL scheme, host, and port.
